Tara: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on the outage. RCA: https://redwood.company/rca/INC-2026-042. Using this thread to capture owners, short ETAs, and any leadership Qs. Keep it tight please. :spiral_notepad:

Ben: I'll own the KV-config rollback doc and smoke-test script. ETA: 2026-03-28 11:00 UTC. Will add steps to `playbooks/kv-rollback.md`.

Iris: I'll update the oncall runbook with new detection thresholds and add a verification checklist. ETA: 2026-03-28 15:00 UTC.

Marco: I can draft the customer note for Hosted + Dedicated and coordinate Legal/PR. Draft 1 by 2026-03-28 18:00 UTC.

ComplianceBot: Logged follow-ups as INC-2026-042-ACTION and assigned Ben/Iris/Marco. Link: https://redwood.company/tasks/INC-2026-042-ACTION.

Tara: Leadership asked: 1) Any SLO changes? 2) Immediate Dedicated reservations? 3) Who is on the 7-day regression watch?

Ben: No SLO changes today. We'll revisit if rollback doesn't restore baseline within 72h.

Marco: We can offer temporary Dedicated buffers for critical accounts; Ops needs to approve. I'll prepare the approval request once Legal signs off.

Iris: Platform Reliability will run the 7-day watch. I'll post a morning dashboard snapshot here each day and a 1-line daily update.

Tara: Please drop your doc links here when done. Also leadership wants a 2-line blurb for next all-hands slide by EOD tomorrow summarizing operational changes.

Ben: Blurb: "Rolled back KV cache change, tightened detection thresholds, and established a 7-day elevated monitoring window with targeted capacity options for Dedicated customers."

Marco: Draft comms posted: https://redwood.company/drafts/comm-INC-2026-042. Tagging @Legal and @PR for review.

Iris: Runbook + alert thresholds updated: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/kv-oncall. Added verification steps and remediation run commands.

Ben: Rollback doc and smoke tests uploaded: https://git.internal/playbooks/kv-rollback.md. Smoke test commands included.

Tara: Great. I'll assemble the consolidated action tracker and schedule a 48h sync. Closing thread for new updates; please append links only. :white_check_mark:
